name: Securemetric Berhad
overview: 2026年公司没有发布任何关于业务扩张、新业务、缩减或合约的公告，只有例行的季度业绩、股东大会及公司秘书变更公告。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比减少7.0%，净利润同比转亏。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any business expansion, new business, reduction, or contract. Only routine quarterly results, general meeting, and company secretary change announcements were made. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue decreased 7.0% YoY and net profit turned to a loss YoY.
